questions.q: According to the summary, who is responsible for a person’s arousal?
a: The person themselves, not their partner
The partner, who must learn the right techniques
The couple’s shared routine and surroundings
Arousal is described as entirely outside anyone’s control
questions.why: Lesson 1 states plainly that you are responsible for your own arousal, which removes a psychological barrier.

questions.q: What universal desire does the summary attribute to women in a relationship?
a: Feeling desired and pursued rather than taken for granted
Receiving expensive gifts and frequent compliments
Having complete control over when intimacy happens
Sharing every sexual fantasy without hesitation
questions.why: Lesson 2 says women like to feel pursued and desired, and that this connection affects their arousal.

questions.q: What does the author suggest a woman can do if her partner stops pursuing her?
a: Limit his access to her occasionally so his interest returns
Criticize him until he changes his behavior
Pretend the lack of pursuit does not bother her
End the relationship and look for a new partner
questions.why: Lesson 2 suggests restricting access a few times, just enough to spark his interest again.

questions.q: What is the first step the author recommends before telling a partner what you enjoy?
a: Be honest with yourself about your preferences and limits
Research new techniques and toys to try together
Ask your partner to reveal their fantasies first
Wait until the relationship feels completely secure
questions.why: Lesson 1 advises establishing your preferences and boundaries yourself before communicating them.

questions.q: How do everyday stress and criticism usually affect a couple’s sex life?
a: They reduce desire and can start a cycle of distance and blame
They have little effect once a couple is emotionally close
They increase desire because tension becomes exciting
They only matter for couples who are already separating
questions.why: Lesson 3 explains that stress shrinks desire and criticism can make a man stop pursuing, feeding frustration.
